'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Emil Wallin LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Emil Wallin]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Communing Girl Scouts. No wiki dest: Rebel Gunner.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See|Dagobah-L-itisthefutureyousee.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Darth-Link
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
